decisions.reason: The I2C series-resistor placement does not change the standalone USB supply, powered rail, source selection, or programming behavior.
The decision changes I2C signal topology, not DCDC1 voltage, capacity, stability, or its role as the normal 3.3V source.
The SDA0 and SCL0 connector assignments remain unchanged; the source only establishes component ordering on the I2C bus.
The source does not add, remove, repopulate, or change the justification of any BOM component; it only confirms I2C series-resistor topology.
The sensor board remains a connector fanout; placing series resistors before downstream I2C devices does not change that requirement state.
The I2C signal-path decision does not affect the switchable 5V rail, its GPIO enable control, or its powered loads.
The source confirms how the existing ESP32-S3 I2C pins connect through series resistors but does not change any GPIO assignment.
The confirmed resistor topology assumes the selected ESP32-S3 but does not change the controller family or WROOM-1 module variant.
The I2C SDA/SCL resistor topology is unrelated to the addressable LEDs' power supply, data GPIO, level shifting, or standby control.
The source does not alter the charge-status display method, CHGLED connector, or associated resistor and population requirements.
Changing component order within the I2C signal path does not alter the number, identity, or separation of project boards.
The source concerns I2C SDA/SCL conditioning and does not change USB D+/D- routing, connector sourceability, enumeration, or flashing behavior.
